reason: An AirTag or a kids' watch does most of what this does for a fraction of the money, and $249 plus $25 a month is a lot to pay for a camera I'm not sure my brother would keep on. I'd buy the cheap thing first and see if it's enough.
objection: Will it actually connect at the moment it matters, and will he keep it on? A camera on someone who doesn't want it is a fight every morning, and I don't have time for that.
would_change_my_mind: A parent in the group who has used it through a real wandering episode and tells me it connected within a minute and the wearer kept it on for weeks.
